title: feat: add `license_details_collapsed` option for collapsible license text
description:
Projects with many dependencies can produce HTML output that overwhelms browser rendering. This adds a `license_details_collapsed` boolean config option that wraps license text blocks in HTML `<details>`/`<summary>` tags, keeping them collapsed by default.

## Changes

- **`config_format.py`**: Added `license_details_collapsed: bool` field to `FormatDict`; defaults to `False` in both `_default_text_format` and `_default_markdown_format`. Added three collapsed template variants (`nameless_license_collapsed`, `named_license_collapsed`, `multi_license_collapsed`) for the markdown format using `<details>`/`<summary>` HTML.
- **`render/package.py`**: When `license_details_collapsed` is `True`, selects the `*_collapsed` template variants instead of the plain ones when rendering license text blocks.

## Example config

```toml
[format]
license_details_collapsed = true
```

When enabled (markdown output), each license block renders as:

```html
<details>
<summary>**MIT text** (click to expand)</summary>

... license text ...
</details>
```

title: feat: add license_details_collapsed option for collapsible license text
description:
Adds a new configuration option 'license_details_collapsed' that wraps license text in HTML `<details>` tags with a clickable summary.

This is necessary for projects with a very large number of third-party dependencies, as the quarto generation of the HTML overwhelms the browser rendering the content. Hiding the license text body by default significantly reduces the rendering time to load the page.

title: Don't treat LICENSE directory like a file
description: We've been seeing some license-mole failures recently due to the presence of a `LICENSE` dir in some repositories, which license-mole fails to open as a file. This small change prevents a `LICENSE` directory from being treated as a `LICENSE` file.
